<!-- pr-reviewer: 1a650da366f4749b7aa82c84cbca2b515ac5db13 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** The new refusal can be bypassed in the normal parameter order.

**What looks good**
- No existing refusal is removed or made weaker. The change only adds a branch for `WireAngle`.
- No golden file changes. `sodick_wire_post` passes (9 tests) after the trial merge with main.
- The warning names the operation and the move ("an angle-word move").
- Mutation check: with the original `sodick-wire.cps` from main, `sodick_refuses_angle_words_even_without_section_taper` fails. With the PR script it passes.
- The decision file lists the evidence and the rejected mappings.

**Results (local, merged with main)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test sodick_taper`: 2 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sodick_wire_post`: 9 passed.
- Not run: clippy and the full quick gate.

**Requested before merge**
1. `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps:148-152`: the refusal sets `sectionOk = false` inside `onParameter`. But `onSection` (line 164-193) sets `sectionOk = false` at its start and sets it to `true` again at the end when no other check fails. In the real stream, `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs:211-221` puts all wire PARAM records BEFORE `Section { begin: true }`. So a `WireAngle` record before the section gives the warning, but the section still posts a vertical cut. I changed the test locally so that `WireAngle` comes before the section. Result: the warning is emitted, and the program still contains `T91`, `C110` and `G01 X-20. Y0.`. This is the silent vertical cut that the PR sets out to stop. Fix: store the angle in a variable (as `taper` is stored) and check it in `onSection` beside the `taper !== 0` check, so `ok = false`. Reset it when the section ends, as the script does for the other wire values.
2. `crates/post/tests/sodick_taper.rs`: add a case with `WireAngle` placed before `Section { begin: true }`. The current test places it after the section start, so it does not cover the order the app uses.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The app does not emit `WireAngle` today (no match in `crates/app/src`). The guard is for direct streams and later work.
- The body says `upstream/main`. The local gate was not re-run by this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 6b9b1c0027ad18816c0d2f7b4b7ed2929b7879a1 -->

**Verdict: Ready for a maintainer to merge.**

This review ran at head 6b9b1c0. The earlier review comment marked head 1a650da3 and asked for changes. This head answers both findings, and the new tests pin them.

**What looks good**

- A `WireAngle` record is now refused in both stream orders. On arrival, `onParameter` refuses it and closes the section (`assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps:149-153`). When the parameter arrives before the `Section` record, `onSection` re-checks the flag (`assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps:190-193`).
- The refusal uses the dedup map (`assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps:74-78`), so exactly one warning names the operation.
- `startCut` and `cutOk` return early when `sectionOk` is false (`assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps:216`, `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps:247`). A refused angle-word move emits no G-code.
- `onSectionEnd` resets the flag (`assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps:335`). One refusal does not affect the next operation.
- `docs/decisions/1496-sodick-taper.md` records why the refusal stays, and what is unconfirmed.

**Law checks**

- Refused move produces no machine move in the output: each new test asserts the refusal and scans the program for the absence of the `G01`, `T91` and `C110` words. Pass.
- No silent pass-through: the `sectionOk` gate covers every motion hook. Pass.
- No `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!` in non-test code: the diff adds no Rust source; the test file's `.expect` calls are in tests. Pass.
- Provenance line: the new test file carries one; the script header is unchanged. Pass.
- CPS conventions: the script stays one file at 344 lines (post scripts are exempt from the 400-line rule). Pass.
- Test placement: `crates/post/tests/sodick_taper.rs` imports only `camcraft_post` items, and its Gate map names that crate. Pass.
- No CHANGELOG edit, no snapshot PNG change, no golden moved, no new dependency. Pass.
- Process files untouched; no `PROCESS_VERSION` edit. Pass.
- PR body has the `Changelog:` line and ends with the issue link; both commit subjects are conventional. Pass.

**Results**

Built locally, in a review worktree; the trial merge with `origin/main` is clean, and GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: 456 passed, 0 failed (49 lib, 407 integration).
- New `sodick_taper` binary: 4 passed, 0 failed.
- Existing `script_sodick_wire`: 11 passed; `script_wire_iso`: 12 passed. Streams without an angle word post as before.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `camcraft-app` was not rebuilt: the diff changes no Rust, and no golden input carries a `WireAngle` record, so the app goldens cannot change.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- An angle-word cut stays refused until a confirmed manual supports the mapping. The decision record lists the open items.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
